name: Rosalind Haeffer
original_name: ロザリンド・ヘフネル
source:
A free citizen born and raised in Grasesta, she is always working on new weapons and armour to assist adventurers in their dungeon expeditions. Unfortunately her lack of experience results in many of her creations being dangerous failures. After her first encounter with Judar, she presses him to help test out her new inventions (which have many unfortunate problems preventing them from being practical in the field). After the field tests, Rosalind volunteers to join the ranks of the Black Pit expeditions and is only allowed to do so by Sheliela provided she is a member of Judar's party.

[Spoiler] Originally from a noble dwarf family, she struck out independently and became a blacksmith. The strap-on ears she wears imbue her with the confidence to work at her trade and improve herself (as well as giving her a stereotypical Osakan accent), but if they are removed she becomes meek, timid and introverted. Lilica remembers seeing her from a high society function, but Rosalind laughs it off even though the former was telling the truth.

Rosalind's strap-on ears hide a long-hidden secret regarding the origins of her dwarf clan. With Judar's help Rosalind eventually confronts the Majin responsible for conquering the ancestral home of her people and exiling her ancestors to Grasesta. Using her intuition, she unearths the weapon forged to kill the Majin and with its help eventually slays him. After the adventure Rosalind discovers she is descended from the royal line of Nebul dwarfs and had the bloodline required to unlock the secrets behind her strap-on ears and the eventual restoration of her ancestor's kindom. [/Spoiler]
